Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.grammar

Class IndexSql

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.grammar.IndexSql
@Internal public final class IndexSql extends Object
Writes the column list and the WHERE clause of an index command for a grammar.

Quoting and the database's own spelling of booleans and collations come from the grammar's protected hooks.

  • Method Details

    • parts

      public static String parts(SchemaGrammar grammar, Command command)
      Writes the index columns with their collation and descending order, such as "a" collate nocase desc, "b".
      Parameters:
      grammar - the grammar that quotes names, never null
      command - the index command, never null
      Returns:
      the column list, never null; ascending order, the default, is not written; for a command with Command.RAW the expression text as it is, without quoting, order or collation

    • where

      public static String where(SchemaGrammar grammar, Command command)
      Writes the WHERE clause of a partial index.
      Parameters:
      grammar - the grammar that quotes names and values, never null
      command - the index command, never null
      Returns:
      an empty string, or a space followed by where and the conditions joined by and

    • literal

      public static String literal(SchemaGrammar grammar, Object value)
      Writes a checked condition value as SQL.
      Parameters:
      grammar - the grammar that spells booleans, never null
      value - a text, boolean or number the index definition accepted, never null
      Returns:
      the literal; text in single quotes with each single quote doubled, numbers unquoted
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if text holds a NUL character
